column1: # Proof of each row of README's 'What PascalsLetter changes' table, run by
# scripts/fork-proof.sh. One line per proving test, tab-separated:
#   area      the README row's first cell, verbatim
#   platform  linux, windows, macos or none; only linux tests run today
#   target    the test file; proxy/tests/... runs in the proxy crate
#   test      a test that passes here and fails on upstream RTK
# A row without a test for Linux has `-` for target and test, and a reason.
# Tests that also pass on upstream are guards, not proof, and stay out.
